title: Walk-in || SrCivil Engineer Drive in Hyderabad For Visakhapatnam as Job location"
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 31 Oct - 01 Nov
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Since this is a scheduled hiring drive, only shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend. The drive will be conducted in Hyderabad, and the exact venue details will be shared directly with the shortlisted candidates.
Contact: Nitu Shukla (9156305648)

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend the hiring drive in Hyderabad on October 30, October 31, and November 1 

 Primary Purpose of Job: Stantec is an engineering design and remediation leader in global infrastructure, water resources, buildings, mining, power & dams, and oil & gas sectors. We provide, program management and technology solutions for the environmental, water, wastewater, energy and power markets in North Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Asia Pacific regions. Stantecs Pune, India office is looking for a Civil designer to join our team and work in Water group.The role is to support project managers/team leaders by providing civil design (CAD/BIM) support to ensure that project outcomes in terms of budget, schedule, technical and quality standards, meet both the client and STANTEC expectations. Design and documentation of projects under the instructions and guidance of a Project Engineer using Civil Engineering techniques utilizing software such as, but not limited to, Autodesk Civil3D, Infraworks and AutoCAD in accordance with Client standards and procedures. Key Accountabilities: Engineering and civil design for Water / Wastewater projects, Stormwater projects Outline design / Optioneering Engineering and designing water and wastewater treatment plants (WTP and WWTP). Leading the technical delivery of various water/wastewater treatment projects. Detailed design Prepare technical reports Designing yard piping, pipe fittings, and connection details Designs related to hydrology and open channels Designing hydraulics for treatment units, associated piping/channels, and site drainage. Conducting outline design and optioneering. Very good knowledge and experience of hydraulics of Rising mains & Gravity Mains, stormwater management Experience of design of pipelines, Pipe fittings, connection details, pipeline renewal Design and layout of Pump stations, pipelines plans and profiles Need to work off-hours for client co-ordination Need to travel offshore for training/on-site work: Occasionally Key responsibilities Technically lead and deliver the design of pumping stations, water, wastewater, and stormwater systems including detailed engineering Work in collaboration with Discipline lead, Project lead, other discipline leads, engineers, and designers Ensure the use of consistent design standards and best practices on projects in line with the technical direction of the discipline Developing excellence by ensuring project efficiencies are achieved Ensure that the quality programs, appropriate design procedures and systems are followed 
 Person specification Professionally qualified Engineer, MEng or BEng (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering having experience in water/wastewater infrastructure projects, Sewerage reticulation, Water distribution, design of pump stations, cross-country pipelines, Stormwater management, open channels, pipe fittings and pipe connection details etc. 5-10 years of relevant experience on working Civil engineering projects At least 5 years of experience of leading and managing Civil Engineering design projects. Experience of working for Middle East projects preferable Good knowledge of construction techniques and practices Flexible attitude to accept different work assignments. Health and Safety aspects in design Working experience of CAD and Civil3D Excellent data presentation abilities (MS Office) Ability to work in collaborative multi-disciplinary engineering environment Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to make decisions independently and strong problem resolutions skills. Good interpersonal skills Willing to work for different regions and willing to learn Professionally accredited or working towards it (ICE UK/ CIWEM)

Key Skills: water,Irrigation,WTP,Storm Water Drainage,Sewage Treatment,water drainage,Water Supply,detailed design
